title: Stop saying "I want to focus." Start saying "I'm someone who focuses."
hook: Stop saying "I want to focus." Start saying "I'm someone who focuses."
caption:
Stop saying "I want to focus." Start saying "I'm someone who focuses."

It sounds like word games, but habit research keeps landing on the same thing: those two produce very different results 🧠

Goal-based change has an expiry date built in. "I want to pass" ends at the exam. "I want to lose 5kg" ends at the scale. Hit the goal and there's no reason left to continue. Miss it and there's no reason either.

Identity doesn't expire. Every time you do the thing, you cast one vote for the kind of person you are. Enough votes and the behavior stops needing to be forced 🗳️
